_about: Documented exceptions for the DEFAULT_EXAMPLE invariant (gh-verify-live.js). Every calculator not listed here must open showing a number its own CONTENT.example states. An entry that starts reproducing its example FAILS the suite as stale and must be removed. Reasons: QUALITATIVE (example has no number / result is a verdict), NO_STATED_RESULT (example restates inputs but never states the answer), NON_DEFAULT_SCENARIO (example is a correct worked case with different inputs, kept deliberately), INTERACTIVE (simulator/stateful tool, no single result), MODE_DEPENDENT (needs a selection before a result exists), OPEN_DECISION (needs an owner decision; see note).
